models.name: DUC series 12 V DC-DC battery charger 30A/40A/50A

gotchas: This is DeviceKind charger, not solar-charger — a DC-DC B2B charger for an alternator or a second bank, which is a genuinely common RV/cabin fitment in Quebec.
EPEver files it under charge controllers in its own catalogue, which is a naming trap: it has nothing to do with the MPPT register map.
No protocol document, no register address, and no confirmation that it has a communication port at all. Recorded so nobody researches it twice.
